description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Activity' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. It defines methods for adding and deleting customer activity records in the database.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Model class for handling customer activity logging, including adding new activity records and deleting existing ones based on customer ID.

methods.name: addActivity
methods.description: Adds a new activity entry to the customer_activity table, recording the activity key and associated data, along with the customer's IP address and current timestamp.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes all activity records for a specified customer ID from the customer_activity table.
